features.title: Premium Eligibility Decisioning for Age and Health

openQuestions.text: What exact platform(s) host the underwriting and Product Administrator screens: web, desktop, mobile, or multiple?
What are the exact configured health fields required for underwriting in this feature?
What are the supported values/enumerations for each health response field?
What exact age range or algorithm defines a “realistic numeric value” for age?
If both entered age and date of birth are present, what tolerance or matching rule determines conflict?
What exact contradiction rules apply across related health answers?
What are the exact eligibility outcome values that can be stored by assessments and rules?
What is the exact definition of “decision source” and “actor or system source,” and are both required on every decision record?
What is the exact “product context” used to evaluate overlapping age ranges, and which fields determine that scope?
How should the system behave when multiple approved active rules could match a single applicant?
What is the rule precedence or conflict-resolution strategy during decision execution?
Are rule drafts versioned before publication, and how are concurrent edits handled?
What exact version-history metadata must be displayed in the rule management screen beyond unique version identifier?
What API endpoints, methods, request/response schemas, and status codes are required for underwriting capture, decision execution, retrieval, and rule management?
Is decision execution synchronous in the user flow, or can it be asynchronous?
What exact authorization error payload or UI message should be returned/displayed for unauthorized access attempts?
For unauthorized access to health information, should protected fields be hidden entirely, masked, or shown read-only with no values?
Who is authorized to retrieve completed underwriting decisions for review besides Underwriters, if anyone?
Can Product Administrators view decision traces, and if so, with what scope?
What retention period and storage policy apply to underwriting decisions, decision traces, and immutable audit records?
What SLA or numeric performance thresholds apply to save, load, retrieval, publish, and decision execution actions?
What accessibility standards or requirements apply to the UI portions of this feature?
What exact sanitization requirements apply to rule-management and underwriting input fields?
Are there any localization, time zone, or timestamp-format requirements for audit and decision records?
